arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1 km out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) drag/weed: watch push_local minus push_along; if it drops within a leg and no pacer clear_rudder, cue clear_rudder. (2) Pod check: every 2 legs compare an out+back pair with measure() (current cancels): falling share of pod power reaching boat with steady HR = pod reading high (drift) -> set pod_gain; rising share = pod reading low. Cross-check with HR vs shaft power. (3) Critical power check from HR trend at steady effort (climbing = above CP). (4) Radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell paddler. (5) Answer paddler when they talk. Keep cues few.
